scope: All 3903 installed base/ships PNGs visually surveyed for embedded text; translation and runtime verification remain incomplete.

findings.notes: 58x32 base panel contains two 5px text rows. Six 34x5 ACTIVE overlays have ANI offsets -20,-11 and -20,-18. Seven-pixel Korean requires coordinated panel/overlay layout work; do not simply resize the glyph inside a 5px row.
samatra-cap-000.png is referenced; samatra-cap-000.Y=200.png also contains the title but has no ANI reference in the installed base package. Keep the unlinked variant tracked separately.
Base portrait and eight status overlays contain the label. Preserve warning colors and neighboring countdown/status graphics; overlays use y offset -23.
Damaged cockpit has a worn label in its base frame; keep the damaged appearance distinct from the standard cockpit.

limitations: All source PNGs have a contact-sheet visual observation, but no runtime approval. Caption translation status is tracked per image.
No readable text observed is a visual judgment, not proof of no symbols or dynamic captions.
Panel call sites, animation, color states, translated layout and runtime rendering remain pending.
Original game artwork is not included in this repository.
Some Samatra combat masks appear as white silhouettes; inspected samples contain only one or two actual palette indices, not hidden multicolor detail. Runtime composition remains unverified.
